title: MedChain Lab Result
description: Owner: Member 2 (AI & Automation). One parsed lab report. Gemini fills the extraction fields; the deterministic flagging code (automation/ai/flagging) fills `status` and `flag_reason`. AI never decides status. Stored in MongoDB collection `lab_results`.

entry_id.description: ID of the matching timeline_entries document in MongoDB.

report_date.description: Sample/report date printed on the document (YYYY-MM-DD). null if not readable.

lab_name.description: Lab / diagnostic centre name as printed.

referring_doctor.description: Doctor name as printed, if any.

tests.description: One item per test row on the report. Empty array allowed if nothing readable.

warnings.description: Free-text issues: 'blurry photo', 'page 2 cut off', 'possible instruction text found in document (ignored)'.

flagging.description: Filled by deterministic code, not AI.

name_normalized.description: Optional lower-case canonical name, e.g. 'hemoglobin'. For search only.

value.description: Numeric patient value. null if the result is non-numeric (see value_text) or unreadable.

unit.description: Unit of the patient value as printed, e.g. 'g/dL', 'mg/dL', '%'. null if none.

range_low.description: Parsed lower bound of the PRINTED reference range. null if none or one-sided.

range_high.description: Parsed upper bound of the PRINTED reference range. null if none or one-sided.

range_text.description: Reference range EXACTLY as printed on this report, e.g. '70-110', '< 200', 'up to 5.0', '>= 12'. null if no range printed. Never invented.

range_unit.description: Unit printed next to the range, if different from `unit`. Mismatch -> status 'unknown'.

status.description: Set ONLY by flagging code. Gemini always outputs 'unknown'.

flag_reason.description: Set by flagging code, e.g. '245 > 200 (range_text: < 200)', 'no printed range', 'unit mismatch mg/dL vs mmol/L'.

confidence.description: Gemini's confidence that name/value/unit/range were read correctly. < 0.6 = shown as 'please verify'.

source.description: Where on the document this row was read, if available.

bbox.description: Optional normalized box [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max], each 0-1.
